instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched Archicad graphical user interface. Do not open Terminal, Command Prompt, or PowerShell; do not run Python, shell, IfcOpenShell, Archicad API, or other helper scripts; do not create or execute any code or macro that directly generates or edits the deliverable files. Use only Archicad native GUI tools, menus, dialogs, and built-in save/export commands. Corner Bakery and Cafe Drawing Set and Room Schedule Start from a blank Archicad project with no init files or local reference images. Build or edit the model using Archicad BIM elements, not visual-only placeholder geometry. Save the completed deliverables in the output folder as result.ifc, result.pdf, and result.txt. Create a single-storey BIM model for the named project. Keep the shaped model within 0.1 m of horizontal extents about X 0 to 14 and Y 0 to 8, with vertical extents about Z 0 to 3.6. Export result.ifc as an IFC4 model with unique GlobalId values for IFC root objects. It must contain exactly 1 building storey and exactly 8 IfcSpace zones named CAFE, COUNTER, BAKERY, DISHWASH, DRY-STORE, COLD-STORE, STAFF, and WC. Assign every listed space to the single building storey. Use the southwest exterior corner as X=0, Y=0. Place CAFE from X=0 to 6 and Y=0 to 5, target area 30 m2; COUNTER from X=6 to 8 and Y=1 to 4, target area 6 m2; BAKERY from X=8 to 13 and Y=0 to 5, target area 25 m2; DISHWASH from X=8 to 10 and Y=5 to 7, target area 4 m2; DRY-STORE from X=10 to 12 and Y=5 to 7, target area 4 m2; COLD-STORE from X=12 to 14 and Y=5 to 7, target area 4 m2; STAFF from X=0 to 4 and Y=5 to 8, target area 12 m2; WC from X=4 to 6 and Y=5 to 7, target area 4 m2. Model the required construction as real BIM element classes, including at least 12 wall-like IfcWall or IfcWallStandardCase elements, at least 1 IfcSlab element, and at least 1 IfcRoof element. If an equivalent exporter writes IfcWallStandardCase for walls, that is acceptable. Do not count IfcBuildingElementProxy or other generic proxy objects as satisfying required walls, slabs, roofs, stairs, doors, windows, or spaces. Export result.txt from the Archicad schedule/list workflow as a tab-delimited schedule text file. The header row must be RoomNumber, RoomName, Area in that order. Include these rows in order: (RoomNumber=B01, RoomName=CAFE, Area=30); (RoomNumber=B02, RoomName=COUNTER, Area=6); (RoomNumber=B03, RoomName=BAKERY, Area=25); (RoomNumber=B04, RoomName=DISHWASH, Area=4); (RoomNumber=B05, RoomName=DRY-STORE, Area=4); (RoomNumber=B06, RoomName=COLD-STORE, Area=4); (RoomNumber=B07, RoomName=STAFF, Area=12); (RoomNumber=B08, RoomName=WC, Area=4). Publish result.pdf as a 2-page drawing set. The visible sheet text must include A101, A201, FLOOR PLAN, ELEVATION, CORNER BAKERY AND CAFE, CAFE, BAKERY, and COUNTER so the title, drawing type, and key rooms or zones are identifiable. Other materials, colors, object names, property sets, layer names, relationship nesting, and IFC representation details may vary as long as the required BIM elements, spatial relationships, geometry ranges, schedules, and sheet text are present.
